newsitem.title: USA: KeySpan, Wickes to jointly market natural gas.
newsitem.headline: KeySpan, Wickes to jointly market natural gas.

text.p: KeySpan Energy Services, a unit of Brooklyn Union Gas Co., and Wickes Inc. said Thursday they have agreed to market natural gas and related services in parts of the Northeast.
The comnpanies said the agreement is believed to be the first between a building-materials supplier such as Wickes and a utility since gas-industry deregulation began last year.

KeySpan began marketing natural gas to customers last summer and now provides natural gas to 10,000 commercial and residential customers in New York, New Jersey and Ohio. The companies will also offer electricity when it becomes deregulated.
Wickes Inc., based in Vernon Hills, Ill., is one of the largest suppliers of building materials in the United States.
KeySpan Energy Services Inc., based in Stamford, Conn., is the largest retail marketer of natural gas in New York State and has expanded to New Jersey and Ohio since starting operations last year.
Incorporated in 1895, Brooklyn Union is a natural gas and energy distribution company. On Dec. 29, 1996, Brooklyn Union agreed to merge with Long Island Lighting Co. to form a new holding company.
